notes: Reproduced OverlayWindow is not a type on the unmodified 4.0.6 source before the fix. Further native tests exposed the absent Style.duration and a QVariantList manifest-kinds bug that omits the app-library capability; Orb supplies compatible fallbacks.

The first cold Nautilus launch exceeded the original ten-second harness deadline. The actual window/location subsequently appeared; the repeat with a thirty-second startup budget passed all nine locations.
An initial app-launch fixture refused shared application directories before writing anything. Final checks use an existing installed app and close only their new window.
The 4.0.6 checkout was temporarily instrumented to confirm its manifest-kinds bug, then restored byte-for-byte to the release source before acceptance.
No video recorded. Historical owner reports are retained separately in docs/history/v0.1.1-ACCEPTANCE.json.
limitations: The 4.0.6 source runs with this machine's installed Quickshell 0.3.2 and Hyprland 0.56.2. The reporter's complete historical OS and Quickshell 0.2.x package set were not recreated; older APIs were checked against official documentation.
Physical multi-monitor, hotplug, fractional scaling and other architectures remain unverified.
Nested input tests do not establish new physical-key or host focus-restoration acceptance. Prior owner reports remain historical.
A hard shell crash can leave runtime bindings until shell restart or compositor reload.
Static checks are not a security audit or marketplace approval.
